notes.title: Dev Diary #3
notes.content: [p]This week we want to share great news with you – we finally added music to the game. In the attached video you can listen to excerpts from the main menu theme, the day theme, and the night theme. Also, pay attention to the transitions between the musical themes – we really wanted to make them smooth. We look forward to your feedback![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="TgF0NL4e2O0;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dev Diary #2
notes.content:
[p]Mobility is king in tactical games. Line up the attack, save your ally, stay out of harm's way – almost everything requires you to be able to get to places. Or not? Why go somewhere if you can shove your enemies around instead?[/p][p]
Force movement in the form of pulling and pushing is a staple of our genre. Now you can look cool doing it too - we added FX animations to our force movement attacks. We draw inspiration for our art from medieval book illustrations, and these animations are the prime example of this approach. Let us know if you like them as much as we doːsteamhappyː[/p][previewyoutube="GOzyb2DT0rg;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dev Diary #1
notes.content: [p]Greetings, knights and vampire hunters! We’ve decided to start a [b]development diary[/b] to share weekly updates about what’s new in the game. This way, you can follow our progress and see what we’re working on right now.[/p][p]Here’s what we’ve done this week:[/p][p][b]1. New language support[/b] The game is now available in more than just English. We’ve added [b]Greek, Spanish, German, French, Japanese, Russian, Polish, and Ukrainian[/b]. Welcome to players from all around the world![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415800/3ee5e86cf61ae12eb84ff0c966d3064e1a0297cc.png"][/img][/p][p][i]We’ve added so many languages that some of their names barely fit on the buttons.[/i][/p][p][b]2. Initiative system[/b] In battle, it’s often critical to know who will act and in what order. Now you can easily check the turn order, helping you plan your moves and improve your tactics.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415800/cb16cf7621977a484ba90198579cbaf1fe6067c4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]3. Save & Load[/b] Playtesters have pointed out that this feature is already relevant, so we’ve added it. You can now save your progress and continue the game later without starting over.[/p][p]Thanks for following the development of our project. Your feedback and ideas help us move forward![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45415800/ac524d6fa75d49e10b14164df59e025fb6c0147f.png"][/img][/p][p]📜 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3291450/The_Vow_Vampires_Curse/#game_area_purchase"]Add the game to your wishlist[/url] to stay updated and not miss the release:[/p]
